title: Tuscan Tomato Gnocchi
subtitle: with Crumbled Feta and Garlicky Broccoli
description: Toss soft gnocchi pillows in a herby tomato sauce, crumble over creamy feta and serve with tender broccoli – it's a meal that will have everyone running to the table.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil for the gnocchi. Finely chop the onion. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks. Cut the head into small florets. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 mins until softened.

Simmer sauce: Add the Tuscan seasoning and 1 tbs tomato paste to the onion and cook for 1 min or until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, 2 tsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and 125ml (½ cup) water, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for a further 10 mins or until slightly thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.
Cook gnocchi: Meanwhile, add the gnocchi to the pan of boiling water (see Kitchen 101), stir to separate, then return to the boil. Cook for 3 mins or until the gnocchi float to the surface. Drain.

Stir-fry broccoli: Heat 2 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the broccoli stem and florets for 3 mins or until golden and starting to soften. Add the garlic and stir-fry for a further 30 secs or until fragrant. Add 2 tbs water, cover and cook for 1 min or until tender. Remove the pan from the heat and season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Add the gnocchi to the sauce and stir until warmed through and evenly coated. Divide the gnocchi among bowls and crumble over the feta. Serve with the garlicky broccoli and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Make sure the water is at a rapid boil before adding the gnocchi to prevent them becoming soggy.
